team_name: A stable Linear team with a configured current cycle
issue_topic: A phrase that matches at least one recorded issue
initiative_name: A stable Linear initiative with projects
document_topic: A phrase matching a workspace document
linear_feature: A Linear product feature covered by official documentation
pull_request_url: A stable Linear/GitHub diff visible to the user
channel_name: A stable Slack channel visible to the user
slack_topic: A phrase with stable public Slack search results
private_topic: A non-sensitive phrase with stable private/DM results
message_link: A stable Slack message with a thread
future_time: A fixed valid future time converted to Unix seconds by the adapter
channel_prefix: A prefix matching joined Slack channels
attachment_id: A stable Linear attachment (deletion is intercepted)
label_name: A Linear issue label that exists on matching open issues
